semanticReview.finding: Nine operations and five queries have explicit imported facade calls to computerUseSettings; shared fN=e6, e6=await $3.services, nIt=hFt and selected app-host publication advertise the Ghe property. Fifteen nonconstructor service methods exist, fourteen are matched. This is a source-qualified static advertised service association, not observed dynamic dispatch or complete service graph.

Selected preload callback applies source/type guard and forwards the port on the bootstrap-published IPC channel; QXe receives trust/context callbacks as F/u and applies F before createAppHost/CXe/registerAppView. Complete QXe and selected complete context constructor/createAppHost members were bounded-parsed; no all-sender-policy or runtime registration claim.

JL has pre/post-await signal checks, abort listener, optional Symbol.dispose and final listener removal/disposal. Five query wrappers pass signal to JL; nine operation wrappers do not. searchMessagesChats independently checks caller signal around serialized invocation; neither proves worker/native cancellation. Remote awaitable disposal implementation remains unresolved.

Xw has explicit win32 options.codexHome ?? c.ot() base and other-platform homedir CUAService group-container JSON path construction. Read/send paths require darwin. Selected missing/unparseable defaults, normalization and direct mkdir/writeFile syntax agree. Supplement resolves node imports and complete Hw migration syntax but not c.ot default resolver, runtime path value, concurrency, atomicity, OS approvals or recovery.

Sound defaults commands are darwin-specific; setter returns requested value even outside darwin. Locked-use status/actions have nonDarwin null and caught status false branches, installer action/status recheck, 120000 timeout, and unresolved imported base. Worker search returns null for nonDarwin or absent callback, otherwise sends messagesSearchChats/query. Ultimate callback/native implementation and explicit backend cancellation remain unknown.

limits: Original fixed source was read only for full pins, UTF16/byte conversion and selected bounded AST parse. Target JavaScript was never evaluated and original target source was not newly copied by this peer. Saved author analysis metadata and output may contain selected source/AST excerpts.

No whole bundle AST was newly parsed. 156 exact or complete selected scopes were parsed, including original 144 units, 7 origin imports, Hw, one syntax-only candidate and three complete context/host members. Whole Program lexical identity outside selected scopes relies on reviewed saved author metadata, not a new entire lexical resolver.

Runtime service instance, actual UI caller/gates, mode classification, native/worker implementation, generic remote Symbol.dispose effects, persistence outcomes, concurrency, rollback and recovery remain unknown. No confirmed ChatGPT-only exclusion or full-feature denominator is inferred.

Own Node/Python offline analysis commands ran and complete source/stdout/stderr/actual exit were captured. Bundled target CLI, target program, UI, network, model task, personal credentials and personal history were not run/read.
